summary: Refactoring of the response relay (router 0.37.2, ADR-0120 proposed), no intended behaviour change. A Shape base class (new module shape.py) with default methods and two stated facts (verbatim, reports_abort_in_stream) replaces hasattr/getattr/`shape is None` checks in proxy._Relay; the native Ollama format becomes OllamaShape; the OpenAI and Anthropic shapes inherit from it; the end of a relayed stream is one helper (_close_stream) for Ollama nodes, cloud providers and OpenAI-compatible nodes. Traced: client authentication, concrete-model rights and routing-block checks run in middleware and _prepare before route_request and are untouched (B1, TM-04). The live memory-policy recheck at the start of _Relay.run still refuses with 403 in every client format before any node or provider is contacted (B4, TM-09). Managed turns still commit before the held success chunk is written on all three streaming paths; the helper keeps the order commit -> terminal chunk -> tail -> EOF and returns the problem response on a failed commit, as both previous blocks did (TM-09). The unary paths keep their own managed handling; the cloud and OpenAI-node unary completions were deliberately not merged because a managed turn on a cloud node cannot be ruled out from the relay alone. The cloud content check, redaction and final payload in _via_cloud and cloud.run are unchanged; no new route, destination or data flow to a provider (B6, TM-05, TM-06). Error handling: a node's 4xx still reaches native clients raw and other clients as the extracted message in their format; Ollama's mid-stream error line, unparsable lines and unparsable unary bodies reach native clients verbatim and are dropped or converted for other formats exactly as before; context-sensitive log redaction and the journal entries are unchanged, and no log line was added (B9, TM-15). The workflow change only adds the new self-test step (TM-16). A normalised byte comparison of 40 path/answer combinations (native chat and generate, OpenAI chat and completions, Anthropic messages; stream, unary, unparsable, node 4xx) between the base and this change was identical; the new self-test's wire assertions also pass against the base code.

tests.evidence: 13 tests OK: Shape defaults, facts per format, abstract methods enforced, native bytes for unary, stream, unparsable lines, Ollama error line, node 4xx; the 8 wire tests also pass against the origin/main router code.

limitations: Review by the authoring agent, not an independent reviewer.

python test/check_adr_index.py reports a numbering gap (0101-0119) because ADR-0120 was assigned ahead of ADRs in other open pull requests; it passes once those are merged and this branch is rebased. The index row itself is generated.

The byte comparison covers native, OpenAI and Anthropic client formats against a synthetic Ollama upstream; cloud-provider and OpenAI-compatible-node streams are covered by the existing self-tests and the end-to-end suite, not by a byte-for-byte comparison.

Pre-existing, unchanged and not security-relevant: a native client whose stream breaks off after the first byte gets the connection ended with HTTP 502 instead of an NDJSON error line; now stated as the fact reports_abort_in_stream = False.
